title: Allow vbms logging configurations to be specified
body:
Currently, `connect_vbms` does not log req/res SOAP message. Because of the recent VBMS issues (https://github.com/department-of-veterans-affairs/appeals-pm/issues/1034), we need the following enhancements

- [ ] Logging of raw req/res SOAP messages. 
- [ ] Allow this feature to be toggled by environment variable.
- [ ] Customization of logging path based on configuration.

Because of PII, the logs should never go into stdout.

While the issue is captured in caseflow, the code change may occur in connect_vbms gem.

# Related Issues
**_Support Ticket_**
File Retrieval: OGC Contractors report that eX file count differs from VBMS [#8](https://github.com/department-of-veterans-affairs/appeals-support/issues/8)
File Retrieval: eX file count differs from VBMS [#13](https://github.com/department-of-veterans-affairs/appeals-support/issues/13)
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: What's the expected result here? Is it `NO REPRESENTATIVE` rather than `8A_NO_REPRESENTATIVE` or is there some phrasing that we need to work on?

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: I think either blank or `NO REPRESENATATIVE`? /cc @gmorgana-va @KHarshawat

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Ok, that question has a few options. Currently, the `value` attribute for each are as follows:

- `8A_POWER_OF_ATTORNEY`
- `8A_NO_REPRESENTATIVE`
- `8A_SERVICE_ORGANIZATION`
- `8A_AGENT`

I can replace with versions that don't have the `8A_` prefix and separated by spaces.
